subject: Calculus

required_facts.conclusion: There exists at least one c in (a,b) such that f′(c)=0.

interpretation: At least one interior tangent is horizontal. The point need not be unique.

Bollywood.style: rhythmic Hindi; retain all theorem conditions

Bhajan.style: devotional Hindi with optional Sanskrit invocation; retain mathematical meaning

Lo-fi.style: gentle phrasing; same note/lyric constraints when a specific melody is selected

musical_constraints: Use reviewed chorus score with note pitches, onsets, offsets and phrase boundaries.
Assign new syllables to notes; permit slurs and score rests, not arbitrary gaps.
Do not present word-chunking or syllable-count estimates as verified alignment.
evaluation_requirements: All required mathematical facts present and correct.
Every prepared line is sung and intelligible to a listener.
Target melody verified by a listener and pitch/timing comparison.
Breaths and phrase transitions follow the score.
No clipping; vocal level clear above accompaniment.
